name: fixture-threads
subject: Review approval threads and a suggested constant
shows: Compare an open file thread, a resolved line thread with two replies, an open suggestion, two review summaries, a general forge comment, and a local comment.

name: fixture-rounds
subject: Keep historical review anchors visible across rounds
shows: Compare two rounds from the same producer and inspect outdated threads with and without a current location.

name: fixture-old-side
subject: Remove the legacy approval bypass
shows: Inspect a removed base-side line and its suggestion fence, which remains comment text with no actionable fix.

name: fixture-hostile
subject: Exercise unsafe review content handling
shows: These inputs break the profile on purpose: bidi and zero-width text, an active viewer URI, a traversal path, and a suggestion outside its anchor must be handled safely.

name: fixture-completeness
subject: Show incomplete producer results without implying success
shows: Compare partial, failed, and unknown runs from three producers with zero, one, and two results respectively.

name: fixture-paging
subject: Page through 230 scanner findings
shows: Load 230 scanner findings over three pages of 100, 100, and 30 results, anchored one per head-file line.

name: fixture-e0
subject: Review an untrusted external contribution
shows: Inspect an E0 push that requires two approvals and a forge author whose NONE association leaves membership unknown.

name: fixture-c3
subject: Review a workflow change requiring two approvals
shows: Inspect a C3 workflow change waiting for a second approval, with two approvals required and no approving forge review result.

base..github/workflows/build.yml:
name: Build
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Check approval policy"

head..github/workflows/build.yml:
name: Build
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Check approval policy and review status"

name: fixture-moved
subject: Refuse stale approval and forge publication
shows: Try Approve with the reviewed commit and Comment with toForge to see MovedSinceReview and PullRequestMoved respectively.

name: fixture-anchor
subject: Refuse a line anchor beyond the head blob
shows: Try adding a new-side comment on line 6 or later of src/Small.java; its head file has exactly five lines, so the anchor must be refused.

name: fixture-unicode-path
subject: A file whose name is not ASCII
shows: A changed file named with a non-ASCII letter, as a path in Review and as an anchor.
